hook: Your first far-side Moon soil arrived in 2024.
title: Soil From the Side of the Moon We Never See
description:
In 2024, China's Chang'e 6 scooped up soil from the Moon's far side and brought it to Earth. It was the first time samples from that side ever came home. The capsule landed in Inner Mongolia. Part of the series If You Were in Space.

#Shorts #Space #Moon
